reviews.title: Revived my old computer
reviews.comment: My old computer only had 256 GB of storage, which filled up quickly and caused the system to crawl. I cloned my operating system to this 1 TB drive, which quadrupled my storage space and brought the computer back to life. It’s running smoothly again!
reviews.author: US  Consumer

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: Yes great M.2 for the price and super good speeds as well. Stays cool and have had no issues at all.
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.title: Good product
reviews.comment: Excellent. Works very well. Good read and write speeds. I got it at a great price: $199 USD. It's hard to find a 4TB drive for that price.
reviews.author: Rudolph

reviews.title: Espacio de Sobra y excelente marca
reviews.comment: Excelente producto, la capacidad es incluso demasiado, ni siquiera he usado la mitad instalando varios juegos muy pesados en mi PC
reviews.author: Angel

reviews.title: No good
reviews.comment: Package came in looking like it had been stepped on.  When I tried to install it my computer wouldn't even see that it had been put in. Would have gave it no stars if that was an option. Don't waste your money on this on. I had to return it.
reviews.author: Cassandra Bradford
